title: Geschichteter Kalkfindling A
description: Zusammenhängender Kalkfindling mit unregelmäßig erodiertem, eingesunkenem Fuß und verstürzten Blöcken. Stark wechselnde, seitlich auskeilende Schichtmächtigkeiten mit Überhängen und versetzten Sackklüften. Ruhige helle Bruchflächen; richtungs-, maßstabs- und keimvariierte Verwitterung nur in Lagerfugen und unter Schichtlippen. Warme Kreide- und Ockertöne einer lokalen canyon_layered-Variante.

review.notes: Round 2 against the round-1 points. Pedestal foot: changed, not fixed. The cut plinth is gone, but the mass now stands on five loose white wedge chips like feet with daylight under it (hero.jpg, turn_200). Fix: bury the lowest bed 0.3-0.5 m into the ground with a sand/fines apron and a few half-buried fallen blocks, no gaps under the mass. Layer cake: partly fixed. Bed thickness now varies, but every bed is a crisp box with straight 45-degree chamfers on all edges, so it reads as cut masonry blocks stacked up, not chalk beds (turn_200, closeup_base). Fix: break the bed edges into irregular fracture faces with undercut recesses and rounded weathered lips; vary the bed outline per side instead of a uniform offset. Scratch pattern: gone, but now the faces are flat clean clay with no fracture texture, and one face in closeup_base has a blue mottled patch. Fix: light rough fracture faces, darker joints, local staining at the foot; remove the blue patch. New defects: a rectangular inset panel with a single slot on the front (hero.jpg) looks like a door hatch; a smooth scooped bowl on the top; a row of small white cubes on the summit (closeup_upper). Remove all three, replace the top with a weathered stepped bed surface with grass terraces as STYLE.md describes. One round left.
